name: alldown
description: AllDown - download public media from a link when the source allows it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @alldown/api" "npm run dev -w @alldown/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @alldown/api && npm run build -w @alldown/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @alldown/api" "npm run start -w @alldown/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @alldown/api && npm run lint -w @alldown/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @alldown/api && npm run typecheck -w @alldown/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @alldown/api && npm run test -w @alldown/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
